newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Hemet Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Hemet Q2 results.

text.p: The Bank of Hemet Thursday announced operating results for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 1997.

Net income for the quarter ended June 30, 1997 was $743,000 or $.84 per share, compared with net income of $524,000 or $.59 per share for the same period in 1996. Net income for the six months ended June 30, 1997 was $1,416,000 or $1.58 per share, compared with net income of $1,043,000 or $1.17 per share for the same period in 1996.
Total assets at June 30, 1996 were $237.6 million -- a 1.4% increase from Dec. 31, 1996.

The increase in net income for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 1997 of 41.8% and 35.8%, respectively, compared with the same periods in 1996 is primarily due to the reduction in provision for losses on loans and foreclosed real estate, and reduced net operating expenses.
At June 30, 1997, non-performing assets were $3,379,000 or 1.8% of total loans and foreclosed real estate, when compared with $5,174,000 or 2.7%, respectively, at Dec. 31, 1996.
